claims.claim: The original GAN framework jointly trains generator and discriminator in a two-player minimax game.
claims.notes: The code demonstrates one synthetic alternating update, not image generation.

claims.claim: The non-saturating generator objective is a common practical alternative to the original minimax generator loss.
claims.notes: The article labels it as a training variant rather than the original minimax expression.

claims.claim: VAE optimizes a variational lower bound comprising expected reconstruction log likelihood minus KL divergence to the prior.
claims.notes: The executable demonstration uses a Bernoulli decoder likelihood.

claims.claim: For Gaussian approximate posterior, z=μ+σ⊙ε with ε sampled independently permits pathwise gradients through μ and σ.
claims.notes: Toy tensor dimensions are checked, not presented as learned image quality.

claims.claim: The DDPM forward process admits closed-form sampling x_t=√ᾱ_t x_0+√(1−ᾱ_t)ε.
claims.locator: Forward process and simplified training objective
claims.notes: The code checks noisy tensor shape and schedule values.

claims.claim: Latent Diffusion applies diffusion in a learned compressed representation to reduce high-resolution pixel-space computation.
claims.notes: The article notes dependence on the representation model.

claims.claim: Autoregressive generation factorizes a sequence distribution into next-token conditional probabilities.
claims.notes: Temperature and top-p are described as decoding choices, not changes to the learned model.
